title: Japan national CPI (September 2026) — the last national print the BoJ's October Outlook Report sees, and an already-registered forward test's missing input
source: EST: stat.go.jp/english/data/cpi/1582.html ('Consumer Price Index — Schedule of Release'), re-fetched direct 2026-10-09 (HTTP 200, 13,839 bytes — byte-identical to the 2026-09-15 read) and parsed cell-by-cell by this event's own never-assessed initial research: the row reads exactly ['September', 'October 23', 'October', 'October 30', ''] — the September-2026 NATIONAL CPI releases 2026-10-23 (a Friday), empty Remarks cell. Corroborated as a pattern, not a date: the August row's 'September 18' held exactly (the national flash PDF's Last-Modified header is Thu 17 Sep 2026 23:31:12 GMT = 08:31 JST on Fri 09-18), and the page's own stamp is still 'Last Update : 23 January 2026'. Filed estimate on this lane's no-self-confirm limit and because the confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for Japan's Statistics Bureau. Release time is not stated on the schedule page; the 08:31 JST Last-Modified stamp on the August release is a proxy, not a source. Checked 2026-10-09
notes: Canonical file written 2026-10-09 by this event's own never-assessed initial research, shadowing proposals/japan-cpi-2026-10-23.from-japan-cpi-2026-09-18.json (read first; its notes — why the date is tracked at all: FT-japan-cpi-2026-11-20-1 consumes it as an input, and it is the last whole-country print the 2026-10-30 BoJ Outlook Report sees — still stand and are not repeated).
